name: sol-advisor
description: Quality-gated Codex workflow with plan-bound implementation, adversarial review, resumable testing, project opt-out, and total-cost routing.

interface.longDescription: Sol Advisor makes bounded delegation globally eligible unless the current workspace opts out, without requiring a child or route record. Task accuracy and first-pass completion are hard gates; among routes that preserve them, it minimizes expected total workflow cost across primary work, child work, result intake, verification, and retry risk. Spark handles compact frozen local production; GPT-5.6 roles handle investigation, synthesis, frozen detailed implementation plans, resumable test execution, implementation verification, and decision-level adversarial review. Context isolation remains a quality and cost mechanism, while the primary session owns direct tool lookups, unresolved design decisions, user finding disposition, bounded evidence checks, fallback, and final integration.
defaultPrompt: Preserve task accuracy and first-pass completion as hard gates before considering delegation.
Consider a bounded child when expected total workflow cost falls, a plan is frozen, or adversarial review improves quality.
Use zero children when tools suffice. Present review findings to the user; use one native final result per turn.
